hook: Elite grandmasters rarely blunder away critical positions in just 6 seconds of intense tournament pressure.

sections.voiceover: Elite grandmasters rarely blunder away critical positions in just 6 seconds of intense tournament pressure.
At the 2021 Meltwater Champions Chess Tour Finals, Teimour Radjabov faced off against Hikaru Nakamura. With only 6 seconds remaining, what forced Radjabov to play 48 Kd2 against his opponent?
The trap snapped shut when Hikaru Nakamura played 48... Ke5, instantly securing a winning position.
After 49 Kd3, Nakamura played 49... Kd5, forcing a resignation due to the crushing zugzwang.
Radjabov resigned the game and ultimately finished in second place at the 2021 tournament.
